title: haageocereus acranthus subsp. zonatus
intro: Haageocereus acranthus subsp. zonatus, commonly known as the 'Pincushion Cactus', is a species of cactus that belongs to the family Cactaceae. It is native to Mexico and has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of Haageocereus acranthus subsp. zonatus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
